title: Nutritious Nourishing Middle-Eastern Grains Mujaddara
description: A comforting, fodmap-friendly, and silkily textured mujaddara featuring garlic and en-croute elements, rich in nutrients and suitable for various meals throughout the day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed and drained split green lentils and uncooked long-grain brown rice. Stir to combine.

Add 3 cups of water to the saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has been absorbed and the lentils and rice are tender, about 25-30 minutes.
Remove from heat. Let the mixture cool slightly.
Using a fork, fluff the mixture to separate the lentils and rice.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
